name: Amethyst Wardancer Helm
description: A lightweight elven helm forged from shimmering silver and inlaid with glowing amethyst. It enhances the wearer's agility and focus.

name: Amethyst Wardancer Cuirass
description: An exquisite silver breastplate that feels as light as silk. Pulsing with violet energy, it offers peerless protection without hindering movement.

name: Amethyst Wardancer Bracers
description: Silver gauntlets that hum with magical vibrations, aiding the wearer's blade-work and reaction speed.

name: Amethyst Wardancer Leggings
description: Form-fitting silver greaves that provide exceptional protection while feeling as light as air. Ornamented with deep purple gems.

name: Amethyst Wardancer Sabatons
description: Ornate silver boots that allow for silent, effortless movement. The embedded amethysts glow when the wearer is in motion.

name: Amethyst Wardancer Cloak
description: A regal cloak of shimmering violet silk. It flows behind the dancer like a trail of shadow and light, granting supernatural grace.
